title: OpenUI conformance expected diagnostics
description: The diagnostics a tool must report for one invalid conformance document. See spec/conformance/README.md.

path.description: JSON Pointer (RFC 6901) to the place of the fault.

oneOf.description: The document is not JSON, for example it has a trailing comma.
An object has the same member twice.
An object has a member the grammar does not define.
An object lacks a required member.
A member has the wrong JSON type, for example children that is not an array.
An element id is not a camelCase alphanumeric string.
A type is not an HTML tag, kebab-case or PascalCase name.
The root version is not a MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH string.
An attribute value is not allowed by the grammar.
An id is used by more than one element of the document; the path points to each use after the first, in document order.
A type is not a known object type of the catalog, spec/openui.json.
